about: The face's reshaping for every figure (#463, the 3D review's second round), laid on each figure's own landmarks by face-ops.py. Radii in mouth widths; s = across, up, depth; back in face widths; drop: how far below the slit, in mouth widths, the chin's pad is centred. Tuned on Vipasyin against the concept's ratios (face-ratios.py). fill: the hollow under the lower lip filled by k of its depth, radius r mouth widths.
